title: IndoSafety: Culturally Grounded Safety for LLMs in Indonesian Languages
findings: Models frequently produced unsafe responses for region-specific sensitivities, which includes the 'Religions and Beliefs' category. Even the Indonesian-centric model SahabatAI had unsafe response rates between 25-45% for this culturally-specific risk area.
